## Systems

### Workflow Studio - https://shivambhaipatel.com/work/workflow-studio
Control plane for running several AI coding agents on one codebase without them
duplicating each other's work. Task queue, DAG runtime, agent dispatch, Jira
mirror, inter-agent messaging.

The engineering point is a package boundary, not the AI. The engine began
coupled inside a VS Code extension and could not be driven from a CLI, an
external orchestrator or a headless worker. It now lives behind
`@workflow-studio/core`, whose tsconfig restricts types to Node - so importing
the editor API from the engine is a compile error rather than a runtime crash.
Four surfaces consume that same core: the VS Code extension, the CLI, the
dashboard SPA, and TradeSense. TradeSense is the one that matters: it is a
separate product that imports the package as a dependency.

Stack: TypeScript, Node, SQLite via sql.js (WebAssembly, so no native modules),
optional Postgres for multi-machine coordination.

### FlowTrace - https://shivambhaipatel.com/work/flowtrace
Records a business process in a browser once, then replays it on demand against
a live ERP and reports each step with a screenshot and an explicit verdict.

Large ERPs are configured rather than merely installed, so every customer
instance differs and quarterly vendor patches break flows. Checking by hand costs
an experienced person about 20 minutes per flow. Automated tests break constantly
because these applications regenerate element IDs every session.

Two design commitments: when a selector drifts, a repaired selector is written
back onto the recording and reused, so the same failure is not re-solved twice;
and the engine independently re-verifies the page rather than trusting a model's
claim that a step succeeded. A refused save counts as a refusal unless the
message is recognisably a confirmation - failing that way costs a false red,
which is visible and cheap, rather than a false green, which is neither.

Three components: Chrome MV3 recorder, desktop build packaged with Electron for
Windows and macOS, and a Playwright replay service. 45 behaviour checks, each
named for the defect it prevents.

Status: recorder and replayer are built and tested as standalone systems.
Integration with the enterprise automation platform is in progress.

### PracharFlow - https://shivambhaipatel.com/work/pracharflow
Template-composition service producing daily marketing creatives for Indian small
businesses and political campaigns, in Hindi, Gujarati and other regional scripts.

The obvious approach was image generation, and it does not work here. Diffusion
models cannot reliably render Devanagari, reproduce an exact party symbol, or
reproduce a real person's face - and on a political hoarding a wrong symbol is
not a blemish, it is a product-killing defect. Non-deterministic output also
makes preview-then-deliver impossible, and preview-then-deliver is the product.
So the system composes parametric templates instead: layout JSON with typed
slots, rendered through Skia via Skija.

Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Flyway, Skija.
Status: delivery over Telegram is in production. WhatsApp delivery is
implemented; end-to-end testing is pending.

## Also built

- TradeSense - multi-agent market research over live market data. It analyses;
  no component places an order in any phase of the plan.
- Enterprise automation platform - Java 21 and Spring Boot orchestration across
  Oracle Fusion, Cognos, Power BI, SAP and Dynamics 365, with a Next.js front end.
- DealDekho - price comparison across six Indian marketplaces. Aggregator-first
  ingestion rather than scraping retailers directly, with a browser extension
  feeding observed prices back through an integration API.
